metricDefinitions.clickToPendingMs: Captured click to first observed pending marker.
metricDefinitions.clickToShellMs: Captured click to visible destination shell and active navigation tab.
metricDefinitions.clickToDataMs: First-visible-data: captured click to the expected visible fixture heading after the destination shell. This is not complete-page or all-data-settled time.
metricDefinitions.completePageDataMs: unavailable: no complete-page settled marker is instrumented
metricDefinitions.authMs: Sum of numeric auth operation durations emitted inside the serial observation window.
metricDefinitions.queryCount: Number of Prisma SQL duration events emitted inside the serial observation window; not exact request count.
metricDefinitions.queryMs: Sum of Prisma SQL duration events emitted inside the serial observation window.
metricDefinitions.rscBytes: Sum of complete decoded RSC bodies observed during the window, including prefetch.
